objectives.title: Accuracy benchmarks
objectives.statement: Measure each agent's accuracy against known correct answers, so that a decline is noticed.
objectives.metric: Share of agents with an accuracy benchmark
tiers: The builder checks results by hand.
Each agent has a benchmark set that runs at release.
The benchmark runs on a schedule against live work, and a decline alerts the owner.
The benchmark set is reviewed by the value owner and refreshed each quarter.
objectives.evidence: The benchmark set and its results over time.

objectives.title: Response times
objectives.statement: Measure how quickly agents answer against the times promised to the people and agents that use them.
objectives.risk: Slow agents that frustrate their users
objectives.metric: Share of agents meeting their promised response time
tiers: No requirement applies to an experiment.
Each agent states a response time and measures it.
Missed response times alert the owner, and the cause is recorded.
Response times are reported to dependents and partners under their contracts.
objectives.evidence: Response time measurements against the promised times.

objectives.title: Throughput
objectives.statement: Compare how much work agents can handle with the demand on them, to find bottlenecks before users do.
tiers: No requirement applies to an experiment.
Throughput and demand are measured.
A forecast of demand is compared with capacity each quarter.
Capacity for peak demand is tested before known peak events.
objectives.evidence: Throughput and demand measurements and the capacity forecast.

objectives.title: Consistency
objectives.statement: Measure how much an agent's answers to the same question vary, so that its behavior is predictable.
objectives.metric: Variation in answers to repeated questions
tiers: No requirement applies to an experiment.
A sample of repeated questions is checked at release.
Variation is measured on a schedule and kept within a stated range.
Variation outside the range blocks a release.
objectives.evidence: The repeated-question results and the stated range.

objectives.title: Continuous evaluation
objectives.statement: Evaluate agents continuously, so that a change in how good their answers are between releases is caught.
tiers: The builder reviews sample outputs.
An evaluation suite runs at every release.
Evaluation also runs on a sample of live work, by an evaluator that is not the agent itself.
Evaluation results are part of each review and are shared with the value owner each month.
objectives.evidence: Evaluation results for releases and for sampled live work.

objectives.title: Regression detection
objectives.statement: Detect a fall in performance caused by a model update or a configuration change, and alert the owner.
objectives.risk: Quality loss after a model update
tiers: No requirement applies to an experiment.
The evaluation suite runs after any model or configuration change.
A regression blocks promotion, and the previous version stays available.
Regressions are reported to the governance council when they reach production.
objectives.evidence: Evaluation comparisons before and after each change.

objectives.title: Factual errors
objectives.statement: Measure how often agents state things that are not true, and keep the rate within a stated level.
objectives.metric: Rate of factual errors in sampled answers
tiers: The builder notes errors seen in testing.
A sample of answers is checked for factual errors at release.
Factual errors are measured on live work, and the rate is kept within a stated level.
Answers that make claims are checked against a source before they are sent.
objectives.evidence: Sampled answers with error findings, and the measured rate over time.

objectives.title: Business outcomes
objectives.statement: Connect each agent's technical measures to the business objective it serves, so that technical success is not mistaken for value.
objectives.metric: Share of agents whose objective measure is reported
tiers: The experiment states what it set out to learn.
The objective's measure from section I is reported each quarter.
The value owner compares the measure with cost each quarter.
The measure is reported to the executive sponsor with the agent's cost.
objectives.evidence: The objective measure, its trend and the value owner's review.

objectives.title: Finding underperformers
objectives.statement: Find agents that do worse than their benchmarks or than other agents doing similar work.
tiers: No requirement applies to an experiment.
Agents below their benchmark are flagged at review.
Agents below their benchmark are flagged automatically and given a remedy plan.
Persistent underperformers are reviewed by the governance council for retirement.
objectives.evidence: The list of flagged agents and their remedy plans.

objectives.title: Timely remedy
objectives.statement: Track how long it takes to fix performance problems once they are found.
objectives.risk: Poor performance going on too long
tiers: No requirement applies to an experiment.
Performance problems are tracked to closure.
Problems have target remedy times by severity.
Missed targets are reported to the executive sponsor.
objectives.evidence: The problem log with dates found and fixed.

objectives.title: Scheduled quality audits
objectives.statement: Complete the scheduled performance and quality audits. The Assurance discipline sets the audit plan.
tiers: No audit is required for an experiment.
Quality is audited at the agent's review date.
Quality is audited each half year by someone outside the team.
Quality is audited each quarter, and an outside auditor reviews the results each year.
objectives.evidence: The audit schedule and completed audit reports.

objectives.title: User feedback
objectives.statement: Collect feedback from the people and agents that use an agent, and use it to improve the agent.
objectives.risk: Signals for improvement that nobody collects
tiers: The builder asks users directly.
Users can give feedback, and the owner reviews it.
Feedback is tracked to an action or a reason for no action.
Feedback trends are reported with the agent's evaluation results.
objectives.evidence: The feedback log and the actions taken.
